setup.heading: Set the DM PIN
setup.intro: The PIN protects the DM view. You set it once, here on the server PC, and enter it on any browser you run the game from.
setupElsewhere.heading: Set up on the server PC
setupElsewhere.body: No DM PIN has been set yet. Open the DM view in a browser on the PC that runs the server to set it.
signIn.heading: Enter the DM PIN
signIn.lockedOut: Too many wrong PINs from this device. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
workspace.noSceneHint: Select a scene in the sidebar.
tree.label: Campaigns, sessions and scenes
tree.heading: Campaigns
delete.heading: Delete {name}?
delete.live: This includes the live scene: the TV will show the idle screen.
delete.changed: What this deletes has changed since the dialog opened. Check the counts and confirm again.
liveBar.label: Live scene
liveBar.none: Nothing is live. The TV shows the idle screen.
sceneMap.image: Map image: PNG, JPEG or WebP
sceneMap.replaceImage: New map image: PNG, JPEG or WebP
sceneMap.tooLarge: This file is {size} MB; the upload limit is {limit} MB.
sceneMap.loadFailed: The map image could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
canvas.label: Map of {name}
canvas.help: On the map: arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 fits the map. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
library.label: Asset library
library.heading: Library
assetForm.replaceImage: New image, if it changes: PNG, JPEG or WebP
assetForm.tooLarge: This file is {size} MB; the upload limit is {limit} MB.
assetForm.name: Name
assetForm.hidden: Tokens of this asset start hidden
assetDelete.heading: Delete {name}?
assetDelete.intro: This is permanent. Its image goes too if nothing else uses it.
assetDelete.inUse: {name} is used by tokens on these scenes, so it cannot be deleted:
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.body: This view stopped working. Reloading it keeps everything the server has saved.
error.code.not_found: That item no longer exists. It may have been deleted from another browser.
error.code.validation_failed: The server refused what was entered. Check the values and try again.
error.code.malformed_body: The server could not read the request. Reload the page and try again.
error.code.bad_request: The server refused the request. Reload the page and try again.
error.code.unsupported_media_type: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are accepted.
error.code.payload_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
error.code.command_unsupported: The server does not support that action.
error.code.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; the server log has the details.
error.code.unauthorized: This browser is no longer signed in. Enter the PIN again.
error.code.forbidden: This action is only allowed from the server PC.
error.code.locked_out: Too many wrong PINs from this device. Wait a while and try again.
error.code.pin_not_set: No DM PIN has been set yet.
error.code.pin_already_set: A DM PIN has already been set. Enter it to sign in.
error.code.reference_not_found: Something this refers to no longer exists. Reload and try again.
error.code.order_mismatch: The list changed in another browser. It has been reloaded; try again.
error.code.confirmation_mismatch: What this deletes has changed. Check again before deleting.
error.code.asset_in_use: This asset is used by tokens and cannot be deleted.
error.code.network: The server did not answer. Check that it is running and try again.
